title: Gutsy field goal decision bails out Caleb Williams’ mistake as Bears beat Patriots in ‘TNF’ thriller

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Gutsy field goal decision bails out Caleb Williams’ mistake as Bears beat Patriots in ‘TNF’ thriller
sources.description: A 58-yard field goal from Cairo Santos bailed out Caleb Williams late in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday night at Soldier Field.
